categories.label: Points on scoring track
categories.hint: Storyteller 3 if some but not all guess; 0 if all or none (others 2). Guessers 3; +1 per vote on your own card.

endCondition.description: Game ends at end of a turn when any player reaches or exceeds 30 points.

notes: family: race-to-goal. Per-turn scoring is tracked on the board; enter final track values. Ties share victory.
